title: Migrate your app to Swift 6
description: Experience Swift 6 migration in action as we update an existing sample app. Learn how to migrate incrementally, module by module, and how the compiler helps you identify code that’s at risk of data races.  Discover different techniques for ensuring clear isolation boundaries and eliminating concurrent access to shared mutable state.
